scope: Absorbed PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 (latest stable on 2026-10-16; 3.0.0 alphas are prereleases) for bounded serial slicing: one closed STL in millimetres or inches, an explicit generic Marlin 2 FFF profile, independent STL analysis, configuration readback, pure-Python G-code replay (layers, envelope, setpoints, feedrates, filament arithmetic, kinematic time bounds) and identical fresh reload. Native acceptance used a CLI-only build of the unmodified version_2.9.6 source; official Flathub/Windows/macOS binaries are unverified. No printer control, upload, physical print, firmware, material or safety claim.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_prusaslicer.py --native with an absolute PrusaSlicer console executable; require all three development cases, independent G-code replay, fresh reload identity, tamper rejection and lifecycle probes.
